products.label: Monochrome
products.process: Decode source map, apply the declared coverage/exposure policy, pack latitude bands, project poles and encode textures.
limitations: Monochrome: Native clear-filter Voyager frames, corrected independently using source capture geometry before compositing. Missing and unstable geometry stay unavailable.

products.label: Enhanced color
products.process: Prepare latitude bands with the declared coverage/exposure policy; sample the pinned original photograph directly for polar sprites, then encode the existing texture layout.
limitations: Enhanced color: Photometrically corrected 2014 map in orange/green/blue. Northern black background was not illuminated by Voyager; original JPEG fill remains missing. Local source resolution varies.

products.label: lighting
products.process: Evaluate the declared surface-lighting model into phase banks.

products.label: Object information
products.process: Compile the authored introduction, facts, dataset descriptions and references into the shared content document.

products.label: Named features
products.process: Verify the pinned Gazetteer archive, decode its attribute table and datum, exclude the declared type codes, anchor each IAU centre point on the prepared body mesh, rank features by diameter and prepare each outline: a rim circle, the published extent, or mapped structural traces selected inside that extent.
